import numpy as np

def expected_time_to_exit(N, M, paths):
    # Create transition matrix
    P = np.zeros((N, N))
    for K, L in paths:
        P[K][L] = 1 / len([k for k in range(N) if P[k][K] > 0 or k == K])
        P[L][K] = 1 / len([l for l in range(N) if P[l][L] > 0 or l == L])

    # Modify the transition matrix for the absorbing state
    P[N-1][:] = 0
    P[N-1][N-1] = 1
    for i in range(N-1):
        P[i][N-1] = 1 / sum(P[i])

    # Calculate the fundamental matrix
    I = np.eye(N)
    N_matrix = I - P[:-1, :-1]
    F = np.linalg.inv(N_matrix)

    # Expected time to absorption starting from state 0
    expected_time = F[0, N-1]

    return expected_time

# Example usage
